parameters.prompt: The exact spider-bodied demon lady in the reference performs ONE ordinary strike in place. From the resting pose she rears the upper body back slightly and raises the two front spider legs, then quickly stabs both front legs forward and down toward screen left, holds for a brief moment, then lowers them and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. All other spider legs stay planted. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, clothing and spider body. Exactly the same number of legs and arms as the reference. No walking, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, shadow or text.
